purpose: Vehicle-scoped guard policy, verified lock/Sentry/location observations, security event history, and explicit emergency commands.
primaryGoal: Review actual security evidence, edit saved policy, and deliberately request arming, panic, or event acknowledgement without implying automatic theft detection.

dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace URL/store/fleet selection; the page does not own a second vehicle picker.
dataSources.evidence: URL vehicle_id, persisted selection, then first fleet vehicle; model consumes the selection at useGuardPageModel.ts:16.

dataSources.ownership: Guard policy hook; router.go:3425 mounts Config, not observed Sentry Status.
dataSources.behavior: Positive vehicle enablement, cancellation signal, guard-config key, realtime staleTime and polling; null is unsaved policy, undefined is unresolved.

dataSources.ownership: Guard event hook and security event response contract; router.go:3427.
dataSources.behavior: Cancellation, guard-events key, positive vehicle enablement, QUICK staleTime, safeArray select from envelope. No date bounds or pagination requested. Counts describe returned rows only; backend completeness and ordering not independently verified.

dataSources.ownership: Existing vehicle state normalization/live query policy; router.go:3333.
dataSources.behavior: Model requests 5-second polling for enabled policy, otherwise 30 seconds. Existing as-of reads suppress polling. Current-field predicate at useVehicles.ts:1117 requires fresh real observation and verified field identity. Coordinates must also be finite and bounded.
Shared geofences key, cancellation, safeArray; documented centroid latitude/longitude and radius in meters. Selected policy geofence supplies the map circle and dropdown.

Explicit user actions only, requiresLiveMode, existing invalidation/broadcast and networkMode. Policy/panic are sudo-gated and limited to 5/min; acknowledgement limited to 60/min. Trailing slash route groups are source matches; HTTP behavior not exercised.

dataSources.ownership: Existing map provider/settings owner, not a page fetch.
dataSources.behavior: getMapConfig, map-config key, five-minute staleTime, existing provider selection and data-saver policy. Configuration endpoint implementation was not traced; no invented endpoint.

components.name: PageLayout / CardGrid / LayoutCard
components.contract: PageLayout forwards PageContainerProps; CardGrid uses stable id/size/content items and localized group label, measured container width and CardPlacementContext. Feature wrappers consume placement.className.
components.use: Five grid items; map/controls/settings/status half, events full; full-width min-w-0 orchestration.

components.name: VehicleOperationalBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Typed raw StatMetric[] and StatPeriod through useOperationalMetrics; optional loading, retained, available, error and footer; preserve per-metric missing reasons.
components.use: Six overview metrics; mixed independent source evidence, not a fabricated theft score.

components.name: FormSection / Button / Select / Toggle / ConfirmDialog / Text / HelperText / Badge
components.owner: Existing category barrels in components/forms and components/ui
components.contract: Existing localized labels, pending/disabled controls, wrapping buttons, typography role/as overrides, danger confirmation. ConfirmDialog supports open/title/message/loading/onConfirm/onCancel and retains shared Modal behavior.
components.use: Saved policy forms, panic action, event acknowledgement; no raw form controls.

components.name: useDataState / StaleRefreshWarning / QueryError / Skeleton / EmptyState
components.contract: Fatal errors without retained data are distinct from refresh errors; StaleRefreshWarning takes DataState, localized label and existing retry; source geometry stays within persistent shells.
components.use: Four independent source states, per-panel recovery, missing vehicle navigation.

components.name: SourceContent
components.contract: Existing ready/loading/error/empty/retained states, localized label/messages, loadingContent/emptyContent, errorRecovery/emptyRecovery and retainedMessage.
components.use: Available reuse candidate for repeated source branching; not currently imported. Must not erase finer unknown/unavailable or verified-field rules.

components.name: MapContainer / Marker / Circle / Popup / MapTileLayer / MapInvalidator
components.contract: Existing Leaflet category exports and provider/data-saver implementation; radius remains meters and resize invalidation remains animate:false.
components.use: Verified coordinates, vehicle marker popup, selected home geofence. No fabricated event positions.

components.name: TimeStamp / formatDateTime / useNumberFormatting / FadeIn
components.owner: Existing data-display, lib/dateFormat, hooks/useNumberFormatting and motion category owners
components.contract: Preserve existing localized timestamps, numeric formatting, and shared motion preference pipeline.
components.use: Alert/events/source observation/policy time and marker coordinates; shared motion implementation not independently exercised.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Policy stale/fatal/mutation-error and policy-effect copy are also shown in settings and overview. These are independent visible contexts, not evidence that a new universal component is needed.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing source feedback and optionally SourceContent for compatible branches; retain contextual policy explanations and independent recovery. Do not extract a competing trust renderer.

issues.detail: Live location's text alternative exists only in the marker popup; the panel has no always-visible location summary independent of the interactive map. Keyboard popup reachability and tile failure behavior are not verified.
issues.fix: Provide a localized source-backed coordinate/vehicle/home-area summary adjacent to the map using existing Text and numeric formatting. Keep the marker popup and map capabilities, and test keyboard access before claiming a11y.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus restoration, screen reader, effective contrast, forced colors, touch and reduced-motion runtime unverified.

states.loading: Local skeletons in map, config controls/settings and events; overview metric missing reasons say Updating. No page-wide loading gate.
states.empty: Unsaved config null is editable; empty events get a real empty state; no current location and no vehicle have refresh/manage-vehicles recovery.
states.error: Fatal source errors remain local; mutation failures retain explanations including possible policy persistence before arming failure.
states.retainedOffline: Existing DataState and StaleRefreshWarning preserve usable data; current-field checks prevent stale vehicle fields from becoming live lock/Sentry/location observations.

issues.detail: Overview does not forward loading even though VehicleOperationalBrief has a loading contract and defaults it to false. Initial loading is classified as Evidence unresolved, while individual missing reasons say Updating.
issues.fix: Derive initial/no-retained source loading and use the existing brief loading contract without suppressing successful independent metrics during partial loading; test initial and mixed-source cases.

issues.detail: Map shows only vehicleState trust/recovery, although its selected home circle also depends on config and geofences. Those sources' retained/failed states are shown elsewhere, not beside the location overlay that uses them.
issues.fix: Add source-specific policy/geofence retained/unavailable context near the overlay using existing StaleRefreshWarning/QueryError, without blocking the verified vehicle marker or losing a retained home circle.

visualIssues.detail: Home-area pathOptions use page-owned rgba blue literals. EventTrail at :96 contains a fixed red hex, but its positions are always empty at :62, so that red is not evidence of a currently rendered trail.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subdued semantic/map palette tokens for the home boundary; preserve visibility against actual tiles and saved chart/theme preferences. Do not create a new palette or fabricate an event trail.

architectureIssues.detail: Sensitivity, homeGeofenceId, autoPanic and panicDialogOpen are component-local states with no vehicle identity reset/keying. Header selection changes activeVehicleId without remounting the page. A draft or open panic confirmation for vehicle A can therefore apply to vehicle B through the callbacks at :85-115.
architectureIssues.fix: Scope drafts and confirmation target to vehicle identity, or reset them on identity change before allowing actions. Retain explicit false and empty-geofence semantics and protect against scope changes during confirmation. Add a two-vehicle behavioral regression.

architectureIssues.detail: Six mutation toast messages at :149,155,173,176,197,200 are hardcoded English. Panic success at :173 says Panic alert triggered even though the page explains that the request does not create a guard event; this also weakens the page's carefully qualified command language.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize through the existing API toast/translation convention and describe requested command outcomes accurately. Preserve mutation rejection, live-mode protection, cache invalidation, raw error evidence and command sequencing; catalog edits belong to the integration owner.

architectureIssues.detail: Sensitivity option labels embed 1 km and 200 m as fixed display strings rather than using saved display-unit preferences. These describe saved threshold policy, not measurements or proof of an automatic detector.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain the low/medium/high wire values and policy caveat; format the existing 1000m/200m threshold meanings at the display boundary using current useUnits conventions. Do not change backend thresholds or add legacy converters.

architectureIssues.detail: GuardControls, GuardEvents, GuardLiveMap, GuardSettings and GuardStatus import useCardPlacement from the layout-reference implementation barrel while public layout components use the category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm the canonical category export for useCardPlacement and consolidate imports only through the designated shared export owner. Do not add another placement provider or edit shared barrels from a page item.

priority.reason: Vehicle-bound draft and confirmation identity is the most consequential source-confirmed preservation risk; presentation is already mostly restrained and decomposed.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing toast.success/toast.error on policy, panic and acknowledgement success/error. Localized success labels and error interpolation; panic text must describe commands, not a created event.
dependsOn: Existing translation/API toast convention and canonical catalog ownership
Guard mutation response and partial-failure semantics
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Integration change; no new shared renderer needed.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Keep the same optional placement object, className, size/span/width and provider identity; expose through the existing layout category only if the shared owner confirms it is missing.
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Conditional export/import reconciliation; category export availability was not inspected and is not claimed missing.

notes: Page is already a thin orchestrator over guard-modernization presenters and existing shared contracts.
Local EventCard and StatusRow preserve guard-specific rendering; one consumer is not enough evidence for a new shared card/status implementation.
SourceContent already exists for compatible async branch reuse; do not establish a parallel source-state system.
Do not introduce a second vehicle/range picker. /guard-mode currently has header vehicle scope and no range scope; the event request does not accept range bounds in this page.

preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus nine non-test files in guard-modernization, including index.ts and eventMetadata.ts; operational brief/shared owners excluded.
actions: Choose home geofence, including explicit none
Change auto-panic preference, retaining explicit false
Save settings with existing enabled policy and unchanged wire keys
Acknowledge an event using vehicle and event IDs
Existing map pan/zoom and vehicle coordinate popup
data: Six metrics: policy/event-trigger state, verified Sentry, verified lock, policy sensitivity including unsaved-draft context, unacknowledged count and total returned events.
Saved policy is not confirmed active monitoring; disabling does not imply doors unlock or Sentry off.
Triggered derives from latest returned unacknowledged non-test event, not confirmed theft; acknowledgement derives from acknowledged_at.
Event label fallback retains unknown event types; IDs, timestamp, state transition and acknowledged_by rendering remain.
No security-event coordinates exist in this frontend contract; empty eventPositions must not become a fabricated trail.
GuardEvent also carries details and acknowledged_at not currently displayed; preserve the wire/cache shape and do not treat their omission as permission to drop fields.
Raw geometry radius remains meters, coordinate validation/current-field checks survive, and display conversion never mutates saved/cache values.
Null unsaved policy, unresolved source, measured zero counts, empty feed, retained/offline data and current verified fields remain distinct.
Existing query keys, polling, cancellation, select, mutation invalidation/broadcast, requiresLiveMode, as-of read policy and authentication safeguards survive.
